name: lastnormal_item_pipe_026

source_description_evidence: One of the classic pieces of mad science glassware, this is a small-volume still that passes vapor through a fractional distillation column and then condenses the distillate in a cooled collection column.  A grad student or a robot (is there really any difference?) collects the distillate in fractions so that specific contents can be analyzed.  Going a few milliliters at a time, it would not be very effective to try to distill whiskey in this thing.
